title: Aliens now arc and drift off-screen instead of wrapping

sections.heading: Changed
items: Aliens fly a curving, arcing path across the field instead of moving in straight lines.
Aliens no longer wrap around the screen edges — they drift off and disappear.
Alien engine drone sounds stop correctly when an alien leaves the screen.
Prong reticule now properly anchors the drift-shot bonus to the first prong angle.

title: Solid crystal gem drops and fragment changes

sections.heading: Changed
items: Solid crystals now use weighted probabilities for gem drops: 60% chance of 0 gems, 25% for 1, 10% for 2, and 5% for 3.
Destroying a large solid crystal now produces 2 fragments instead of 3.
The in-game bonus label has been renamed from "DRIFT BONUS" to "DRIFT SHOT".

title: Dev log button and aim disc visual improvements

sections.heading: New
items: A new "dev log" button in the overlay lets you open and close the latest dev log entry at any time.
An indicator dot appears on the dev log button when there is an unread entry.
The dev log panel can now be dismissed with the Escape key.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Aim disc color now correctly matches your ship's trajectory chevron color.

title: Solid crystals, manta aliens, and stinger bullets

sections.heading: New
items: Solid crystal asteroids appear in waves — tougher than normal rocks, they shatter into fast fragments and drop collectible gems.
Alien ships now sport a sleek manta-ray silhouette with curved wings, cephalic horns, glowing structural ribs, and an animated whip tail.
Big aliens fire an 8-shot fan burst in a wide arc, then pause before the next volley.
Alien bullets now appear as slim stinger darts instead of round blobs.
The big alien's fire sound uses a sampled electric guitar.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Ship trajectory preview now shows directional chevrons instead of dots for clearer heading indication.
Aim disc rendering distinguishes between primary and secondary weapon slots.
Gold crystals shatter on ship contact with an updated sound effect.
